name: grapesjs-site-pages
description: GrapesJS plugin: a Pages sidebar — pages in IndexedDB with per-page undo/redo, copy/paste between pages and manual REST sync, or (remote mode) a server-first CMS editor with layouts, templates, a page tree, publishing and revisions; the whole site exports to and imports from a ZIP archive.

scripts.build: vite build && vite build --config vite.archive.config.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.json --emitDeclarationOnly && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('dist/grapesjs-pages.umd.cjs','dist/grapesjs-pages.umd.js')"
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build

author: Alexander Shibisty
